themes.aiDesc: Generative AI, machine learning and predictive analytics applied to geospatial data and territorial decision-making.
themes.twinDesc: Dynamic digital replicas of the territory — cities, infrastructure, networks — to simulate, plan and anticipate.
themes.envDesc: Mapping climate change, monitoring ecosystems, biodiversity and geomatics in service of ecological transition.
themes.aicoDesc: Geospatial governance, public organizations and communities of practice in the era of collective intelligence and open data.

why.networkDesc: Meet more than 400 professionals, researchers and decision-makers in the geospatial sector.
why.expertiseDesc: Speakers from the public, private and academic sectors.
why.innovDesc: Artificial intelligence, digital twins, environment: the trends transforming geospatial.
why.vitrineDesc: The latest geospatial solutions presented by exhibitors, with live demonstrations on site.
why.awardDesc: Attend the presentation of the GAÏA Prize, awarded by the ACSG since 1993 to honour a remarkable contribution to geomatics in Quebec.
why.reseauDesc: Build lasting connections with Quebec's geomatics community: colleagues, partners, employers and the next generation.
